officialRef.pdf: 初2第3辑初初中时文阅读提分训练3+X第3辑8年级答案.pdf

q1.explanationZh: 第二段说 2019 年 Skype 是下载最多的应用之一，所以它是一款 app（应用软件）。

evidence.quote: In 2019, Skype ranked among the top 10 most downloaded apps of the 2010s, ahead of TikTok and Twitter.

q2.explanationZh: 第六段说妈妈接电话还是习惯拿起听筒，她用的是座机，也就是 landline。

evidence.quote: my mother still prefers to pick up the receiver when a phone rings, as she always has

q3.explanationZh: 第四段说那时每说一句话要花大约两美元，所以打长途电话要“斟酌用词”，因为太贵了。

evidence.quote: Back then, every sentence cost me about two dollars.

q4.explanationZh: 最后一段说科技飞速前进，妈妈显得越来越老、越来越远、越来越难联系上，意思是她跟不上新科技，感觉像耳边的一声低语。

evidence.quote: As technology races ahead, she seems older, farther away, less reachable.

q5.explanationZh: 作者既表达了对 Skype 告别的感慨（①），又写了科技变化让老年人（妈妈）离我们越来越远（④）。②只是陈述事实，③文中没有提到。

evidence.quote: It turned out to be our last such communication ever.
As technology races ahead, she seems older, farther away, less reachable.
